text:
Mia Chen: dropping a new compact card concept for the Usage & Billing tile. trying to show org + top projects + token snapshot without expanding. mock: https://drive.redwood/new-compact-card.png :card_index:
Devon Patel: looks promising. can we keep the token rows visible? ops teams want model cost right away, not behind a click
Raja Iyer: prefer a tiny inline table: Model | Tokens | USD. 3 rows max, then overflow. sparkline above for trend
Sasha L: if we put the org/project toggle at the top, we risk losing which org is active. suggest a small chip/breadcrumb: [Org: Redwood Inc] next to toggle
Olivia Park: accessibility flag: the grey text on the micro table is failing contrast. need >= 4.5:1 for 14px. also ensure focus outlines on chart controls
Mia Chen: noted. will increase contrast and add focus states. also thinking invoice CTA becomes an icon-only on narrow screens (<480px) to save space
Eli (PM): caution on icon-only CTA. support tickets noted users missed the download affordance. compromise = icon + sr-only label or tooltip on hover/longpress
Devon Patel: visual tradeoff: sparkline vs stacked area for spend composition. sparkline is compact but hides per-model surges. stacked area shows composition but dominates the card
Raja Iyer: proposal: density toggle. compact= sparkline + inline token rows. expanded= stacked area + legend. default to compact for dashboard density
Sasha L: copy tweak suggestion: change header from "Token Breakdown" to "Token cost by model" — clearer for new users
Olivia Park: proposed aria-labels: replace vague aria-label="usage-chart" with aria-label="monthly spend and token cost by model"
Mia Chen: will update figma. quick tooltip schema to use: ```json
{"column1":"Model","column2":"Tokens","column3":"Cost (USD)"}
```
DesignBot: a11y scan: micro-table contrast 0.36 (fail). chart control buttons missing keyboard focus and ARIA roles
Eli (PM): priority list: 1) micro-table contrast to AA 2) clear invoice CTA for mobile 3) keep date range sticky when switching org/project. density toggle and overflow modal are nice-to-have for next sprint
Devon Patel: UX nit: when switching scope (org -> project), do NOT reset the date range. losing time range is confusing
Mia Chen: good call. will persist date range per user/session. also will implement breadcrumb chip + tooltip for icon CTA and update aria labels
Raja Iyer: for org-level card with many projects, show top 3 projects with miniature bars and a "show all" overflow that opens a small modal (focus trap + close btn labelled)
Sasha L: modal accessibility reminder: trap focus, set initial focus to close btn or first interactive element, ensure Escape closes it
Olivia Park: invoice filename pattern request for accounting: <org-slug>-YYYY-MM-invoice.csv, e.g., redwood-inc-2025-03-invoice.csv
Mia Chen: thanks all. I'll push updated frames with higher contrast, breadcrumb chip, icon-CTA + tooltip, and sticky date behavior. will post link when ready :white_check_mark:
